skills.name: Cost-aware delegation
skills.description: Decide whether a task needs a frontier model at all, and say which tier is actually justified.
skills.body:
# Cost-aware delegation

Before you reach for a strong model, answer three questions in writing:

1. **What does this task actually require?** Parsing, summarising and re-formatting need none of the reasoning a frontier model is priced for.
2. **What is the cost of being wrong?** A wrong intake summary costs a re-run. A wrong migration costs a day.
3. **Is the expensive model buying anything?** If you cannot name the specific step that needs the extra capability, you do not need it.

## Say this

> This is a summarise-and-reformat task. A small model is sufficient; I would spend the budget on the review stage instead.

## Not this

> I will use the most capable model available to be safe.

Safety is not a reason to escalate. Specific, named difficulty is.

routingRules.description: Intake and summarising are mechanical: prefer the cheapest capable model, and prefer a local runtime when one is configured.
A summary never needs the strongest tier.
